label: ZN cross-asset 5-day daily mean reversion overnight (Friday shorts true 5R) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `ZB 5-day daily mean reversion overnight (Friday shorts true 5R)`. Local mutation of Daily Tsmom Next Overnight; filter: short signals on weekday 4. Uses true bracket stop/target management at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` only after strict forward PF improved from 2.16 to 2.27.
verificationSummary: Management sweep `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` strict PF 2.27 over 90 trades, beating baseline PF 2.16; train PF 1.17, bootstrap p05 1.50, block-bootstrap p05 1.42, odd/even min PF 2.27, annual pass rate 100%.
